subject: Req routing & temporary hiring pause — Q4 headcount reallocation
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Reallocation proposal: Q4 requisitions (need decision)

Team —

I ran a pass on Q4 hiring and attached a lightweight plan (headcount_plan_v3.xlsx) that shows two immediate asks:
- Pause req #HRREQ-5123 (Backend IC, non-customer-facing) pending capacity review
- Move one open offer buffer (5 FTEs pool) to Platform infra recruiting to accelerate cache/runtime hires

Rationale: our telemetry shows the infra backlog causing the highest operational risk for Dedicated customers; moving one headcount now reduces that by ~20% according to Marcus's throughput model.

Asking for a quick sign-off on a temporary pause (30 days) and permission to re-route the FTE into a prioritized infra req. If we approve, Tessa, can you route the paused reqs through the new short-form approval?

Attachment: headcount_plan_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 94KB)

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reallocation proposal: Q4 requisitions (need decision)

Thanks Laura — got the plan and looked through the numbers. A couple quick operational notes:

1) For the pause, we should clearly mark the candidate-facing reqs (sourcing paused) vs backfills (allow immediate backfill if mission-critical).
2) I can route HRREQ-5123 through the short-form approval today if we have a short justification (one-paragraph) and the receiving manager signs off.
3) We should capture any comp band implications before we move an open offer buffer into infra — Marcus, can you confirm the expected band spread?

I will hold off communicating to external recruiters until we have a final decision.

Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Sr. Talent Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reallocation proposal: Q4 requisitions (need decision)

Thanks — quick decision from leadership side: implement a targeted, temporary hiring pause for lateral IC roles in non-customer-facing product teams for 30 days. Exceptions: critical infra/platform backfills or roles flagged as enabling revenue/customer SLAs.

Action items:
- Tessa: mark affected reqs as "paused - leadership" and notify TA ops to stop active outreach to external agencies.
- Marcus + Laura: confirm which reqs meet the exception criteria and provide a 1-line justification per req.
- Marissa: coordinate with Compensation to ensure re-routing budget doesn't violate bands/offer buffers.

We want minimal disruption to offers already accepted — do not cancel signed offers. We are pausing new offer extends for paused reqs.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference

Quick notes on bands and impact:
- The infra roles we're prioritizing sit primarily in band 5 and 6; moving one FTE from the offer buffer is feasible if we re-balance at the job family level.
- HRREQ-5123 (backend IC) is currently band 4; pausing it buys us ~6 weeks of runway on hiring spend but has minimal immediate revenue impact.
- If we redirect the buffer to infra, expect hiring velocity to improve by ~30% for the next 60 days (rough estimate from recent channel utilization metrics).

I attached a short band_summary_q4.pdf for reference.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Infrastructure Engineering
Redwood Inference

Agree with leadership direction. A couple of operational flags from People/Comp:
- Aditya, need a quick confirm on whether moving an FTE from the open offer buffer into infra requires an uplift to the comp pool or if we can keep the spend neutral within the same hiring tranche. If we need additional comp room, that will need finance approval.
- For paused reqs that already have active offers in-flight: do not rescind; instead set candidate comms to "offer under review" scripts (TA Ops template) while we finalize routing.

Tessa — once Aditya confirms comp treatment, please update the Google sheet and route HRREQ-5123 through the short-form doc sign-off. I'll prepare the candidate comms templates if we pause externally.

1) Leadership approved a 30-day targeted pause on lateral IC roles for non-customer-facing product teams (Vivek). Exceptions: infra/platform backfills and roles tied to customer SLAs.
2) Marcus and Laura to list exception reqs (1-line justification per req) by EOD Monday 11/15.
3) Aditya to confirm comp treatment by EOD Friday 11/13 — status: awaiting his note (see CC).
4) Tessa/TA Ops will mark paused reqs in Greenhouse as "Paused - Leadership" and stop agency outreach once decisions are posted.
5) Marissa will prep candidate comms templates for paused reqs; do not rescind any signed offers.

Links & attachments: headcount_plan_v3.xlsx, band_summary_q4.pdf, Google sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1QHeadcountPlanExample, Jira: HRREQ-5123.

If Aditya confirms we can rebalance within the same comp tranche, I'll initiate the short-form reroute for the one-off buffer transfer. Otherwise, we'll queue finance approval.

Thanks all — I will post the final paused req list and update TA Ops.
